_comment: SDXL background-replacement workflow (ComfyUI API format). Same proven shape as replace_object.json, but the mask is the BACKGROUND region (everything the foreground does not cover). The graph STRUCTURE lives here; backend/comfy_background.py injects per-request VALUES by node id (never rebuilds the graph). Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the init image (original foreground over the uploaded background) -> restrict denoising to the background via SetLatentNoiseMask -> KSampler harmonises only the backdrop to the foreground's lighting -> decode -> save. The foreground latent is fixed, so foreground objects are preserved; the backend additionally re-composites the crisp original foreground at full resolution.

inputs.text: blurry, lowres, distorted, deformed, artifacts, seam, extra objects, watermark, text
